receive.title: Receive: connect to the server

receive_entities.description: Pick the shared entities to show in this Home Assistant. You can change the selection later under Configure.

share.title: Share: connect to the server
share.description: Enter the address of the server and a token that may write.

share_entities.description: Pick the entities of this Home Assistant to send to the server. They are sent once now, then on every change and every 4 hours. You can change the selection later under Configure.
